task: Add ZIP archive upload support to file-type knowledge base datasources with decompression bomb guard, file count cap, Apple Double filter, nested ZIP skip, and duplicate filename dedup.

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Decompression bomb prevention (chunked reads bypass spoofable info.file_size metadata), ZIP path traversal (flat-name extraction), Apple Double resource fork filtering, nested archive skip
technical_risk.mitigation: Chunked streaming read accumulates actual decompressed bytes against a 500 MB cap; basename extraction strips directory components; constants patchable in tests for guard verification

key_reasoning.reason: Security-sensitive ZIP processing: decompression bomb guard uses chunked reads (info.file_size is spoofable), path traversal mitigated via basename flattening, Apple Double resource forks filtered — bumped from S to M by security red flag.

Two production components modified (FileDatasourceService service class, index_knowledge_base_files router handler) spanning 2 layers; new _expand_zip_file static method is self-contained within the service.

Diffstat reports 6 files changed (522 insertions, 23 deletions). Three named: router, service, and new test file. Three additional unlisted files (likely planning/docs artifacts). Fits M band (5–7 files).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from S (2) to M (3): decompression bomb guard and ZIP input security validation constitute explicit security requirements.
